description: Source code for git log-tree functionality, handling commit decorations, diff display, and log output formatting.

methods.name: decorate_get_color
methods.description: Returns the color string for a given decoration type if color is enabled.

methods.name: add_name_decoration
methods.description: Adds a decoration to an object with a specific type and name.

methods.name: get_name_decoration
methods.description: Retrieves the decoration associated with an object.

methods.name: match_ref_pattern
methods.description: Checks if a reference name matches a pattern, considering wildcards and prefix skipping.

methods.name: ref_filter_match
methods.description: Determines if a reference name passes include/exclude pattern filters.

methods.name: add_ref_decoration
methods.description: Adds decorations for references, including grafted and tagged objects.

methods.name: add_graft_decoration
methods.description: Adds grafted commit decorations.

methods.name: load_ref_decorations
methods.description: Loads decorations for references, grafts, and ref filters.

methods.name: load_branch_decorations
methods.description: Loads decorations specifically for branch references.

methods.name: show_parents
methods.description: Displays parent commits in abbreviated form.

methods.name: show_children
methods.description: Displays child commits in abbreviated form.

methods.name: current_pointed_by_HEAD
methods.description: Finds the decoration for the current branch pointed to by HEAD.

methods.name: show_name
methods.description: Adds a reference name to a string buffer, formatting based on decoration flags.

methods.name: format_decorations
methods.description: Formats commit decorations into a string buffer, including branch, tag, and HEAD info.

methods.name: show_decorations
methods.description: Displays decorations for a commit if enabled.

methods.name: fmt_output_subject
methods.description: Formats the commit subject line for output, including reroll count and max length.

methods.name: fmt_output_commit
methods.description: Formats a commit's output filename with subject and revision info.

methods.name: fmt_output_email_subject
methods.description: Formats the email subject line for a set of commits.

methods.name: log_write_email_headers
methods.description: Writes email headers for a commit, including MIME parts and references.

methods.name: show_sig_lines
methods.description: Displays signature verification lines with color formatting.

methods.name: show_signature
methods.description: Displays the signature of a commit if available.

methods.name: which_parent
methods.description: Finds the parent index of a given object ID in a commit.

methods.name: is_common_merge
methods.description: Checks if a commit is a simple merge with exactly two parents.

methods.name: show_one_mergetag
methods.description: Displays information about a mergetag, including verification.

methods.name: show_mergetag
methods.description: Iterates over mergetags for a commit and displays them.

methods.name: next_commentary_block
methods.description: Adds a separator or newline in output for comments.

methods.name: show_diff_of_diff
methods.description: Displays interdiffs for commits, including range diffs.

methods.name: show_log
methods.description: Outputs the commit log with formatting, decorations, and signatures.

methods.name: log_tree_diff_flush
methods.description: Finalizes and outputs the diff queue, including logs.

methods.name: do_diff_combined
methods.description: Performs a combined diff for merge commits.

methods.name: setup_additional_headers
methods.description: Prepares additional headers for diff output based on pathspec.

methods.name: cleanup_additional_headers
methods.description: Cleans up additional headers after diff output.

methods.name: do_remerge_diff
methods.description: Performs a re-merge diff between two parent commits.

methods.name: log_tree_diff
methods.description: Generates diffs for a commit, handling merges and root commits.

methods.name: log_tree_commit
methods.description: Outputs a commit log with optional decorations, signatures, and diffs.
